definitions.gloss: actual combat, real battle, real-world competition
definitions.explanation: Real fighting or competition as opposed to training, drills, or theory. Used in military, sports, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {実戦|じっせん}⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧だ。
examples.english: He has abundant real combat experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧{実戦|じっせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{試|ため}したい→試す：02130_tamesu⟧。
examples.english: I want to test my abilities in real competition, not just in practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{武器|ぶき}→武器：03605_buki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{実戦|じっせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}われた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、{訓練用|くんれんよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: This weapon was never used in actual combat; it was developed for training.

notes:
{実戦|じっせん} combines ⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧ (actual, real) and ⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ (battle, war).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実戦|じっせん}⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧ (real combat experience)
- {実戦|じっせん}⟦{配備|はいび}→配備：25292_haibi⟧ (deployment for actual use)
- {実戦|じっせん}⟦{形式|けいしき}→形式：00211_keishiki⟧ (real-match format)
- {実戦|じっせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (usable in real situations)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {実戦|じっせん} vs. ⟦{実践|じっせん}→実践：08241_jissen⟧: These are homophones with different kanji and meanings. {実戦|じっせん} (⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ = battle) means "actual combat." ⟦{実践|じっせん}→実践：08241_jissen⟧ ({践|せん} = carry out) means "practice, putting into action." ⟦{実践|じっせん}→実践：08241_jissen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to put into practice) is far more common in everyday use.
